text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
One day, with the Queen Elizabeth II Cup fast approaching.
Sweep Tosho stood out on the track...
completely unmoving.

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: No!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Her selfishness is as relentless as ever.
Yet, if you follow where her gaze is leading—

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
Haa... haa...
Thank you for matching my pace~.

text_block_list.name: Light-Blue-Ribbon Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
Fufu. Great work to you too, Kawakami-san.
That sudden final spurt really surprised me.

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, but Sweep-san is our opponent after all!
If we don't go at full blast, we'll be utterly crushed!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
And when the real race comes...
........................

text_block_list.name: Light-Blue-Ribbon Umamusume
text_block_list.text: ? What's wrong, Kawakami?

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: ...Senpai!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
"Truly. Really, truly! I am so very sorry
for bumping into you that day!"

text_block_list.name: Light-Blue-Ribbon Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
! ...Geez, I've told you so many times already,
you don't need to apologize.

text_block_list.name: Light-Blue-Ribbon Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
So come race day, don't hold back and bring the fight to me.
I'm not going to hand over 1st place either.

text_block_list.name: Light-Blue-Ribbon Umamusume
text_block_list.text: To Sweep-san, and to you as well.

text_block_list.name: Light-Blue-Ribbon Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
Aah, but listen. From now on,
don't do anything you yourself know is reckless!

text_block_list.name: Light-Blue-Ribbon Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
You're far too kind, so whenever something happens,
you always dwell on it.

text_block_list.name: Light-Blue-Ribbon Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
Now that we've become rivals,
I want us to keep giving it our all
and competing with each other for a long time to come.

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
As a princess, I will definitely keep that promise!
On the day of the Queen Elizabeth II Cup!
From now on! And for eternity!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: ...Hmph.
choice_data_list: Those two have great looks on their faces.
Those two have great looks on their faces.

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: Well, of course!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
"I went out of my way to cast race magic just for the two of you!
I'd be in trouble if you didn't!"

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
I'm the genius magical girl Sweepy!
There's no magic I can't do!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: Still...

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
...Familiar! Next, I'll use race magic
to fill the whole world with witches!!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
I'm gonna make it so everrryone can use magic.
And then everyone in the whole wide world will become my apprentices!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Heheh♪ And I'm gonna keep bossing
everyone around forever and ever!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: "Because I refuse to accept a world that gets boring just 'cause I'm gone."

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
"A world with magic in it
always has to be fun!"

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text: And it is that time of year once again for the Queen Elizabeth II Cup!

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
Will this be a triumphant return for the queen who conquered the Takarazuka!?
All eyes are on whether any other Umamusume
can manage to defeat her!

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
“......Is this really the Queen Elizabeth II Cup?
When I used to watch it on TV, it felt so much more—”

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Whoa, whoa, getting cold feet now?
Scarlet?

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
You were the one who invited me, weren't you?
Saying, "Your debut is coming up soon,
so you should watch a top-tier race."

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
Hah!? Who says I'm scared!?
Your sheer stupidity never ceases to amaze me!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: Ah!?

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
The Queen Elizabeth II Cup I'd always watched on TV
was so much more beautiful, graceful, and elegant.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
Enough to make even me admire it.
Still, this atmosphere is—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (WOOOOOOOOOOO!)

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
"It's gritty, but it's cool.
It gives you the feeling that something amazing is about to happen."

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
I mean, you grumble and complain, but...
Just be honest with yourself, Scarlet.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: "You like races that get people fired up like this, don't you?"

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: ...Fufu.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: —Welcome back to the turf.

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: Alright then, you guys know the drill, right?

text_block_list.name: Light-Blue-Ribbon Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
Yeah. I'm coming to beat you.
With everything I've got.

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: Victory belongs to me, you know?

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
Be my guest.
I'll blast right past you too!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: Hmph. Well then—

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: Yes, look forward to it.

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: And have a whole, whole lot of fun!!
